context: Pre-tag review of the 2.14.0 diff confirmed 8 findings (1 major: lifecycle_reverts false-positives on sanctioned downgrades); all fixed TDD — detector narrowed to overridden/superseded, override read-back race-tolerant, persisted checked at all 5 remaining call sites, revert count surfaced in ingest summaries. 1637 green.
rationale: those have no sanctioned undo verb, so a file-wins downgrade is either branch divergence or a discarded write; active→provisional (reconsider) and archived→anything (unarchive) are first-class flows that legitimately arrive via git and were firing false alarms in the exact channel field users will watch. Message now names both remaining causes. Alternative rejected: extras-presence heuristics — fragile across mixed-version stores.
summary: Chose to arm the revert detector only for db-status overridden/superseded (REVERT_WATCHED)
